scope: D2 clean committed source portability with explicit reachable-history sharing approval

checks.detail: Exact commit imported; missing export/import approval, changed origin and tampered artifact rejected

Three resources imported from approved bundles; repaired Orders commit fetched from second bundle; four failures and four passes reproduced; local relevance contrast accepted while overall coverage remained unknown

limits: A Git bundle carries all history reachable from the pinned HEAD, which may contain old secrets; the exporter requires explicit approval of that history per resource.
Only clean committed Git revisions are supported. Dirty staged, unstaged, deleted and untracked content still needs an approved content snapshot.
The fixture deletes its temporary bundles after validation. Durable Team storage, two-user import authorization, service prerequisites and general runner integration remain open.
Import materializes source after approval but never installs dependencies or runs imported project commands.
